content: {"like": ["Season 5 is solid and enjoyable", "Crimes are cleverly conceived (for the most part)", "Watching the team solve them is enjoyable", "Department shake up and long overdue promotion in the finale", "The show’s strength in dealing with major crimes makes it one of TV’s best procedurals"], "dislike": ["Too much Rusty and his tiresome relationship with Gus", "Rusty’s unrealistic access to sensitive information inside the LAPD", "The increasingly cloying romance between Capt Raydor and Lt Andy Flynn with no chemistry", "Sharon remains a cold fish and seems more invested in the copier than Flynn", "The personal lives of the characters are less compelling", "Disappointment that the show is ending"]}
